18.headline: Jokić drops 50 and buries the Stingrays
18.dek: Rochester is 15-3 and three games clear, Durham took the 2 seed by running Queens off the floor, and Ithaca lost a ninth straight.

games.text: Nikola Jokić took 18 shots and missed three of them. He finished with 50 points, 14 rebounds and 16 assists, which covers most of what Rochester did, and the Dragons beat Stony Brook 139-127 after trailing 98-96 through three quarters. There were 22 lead changes before a 43-point fourth quarter ended the discussion. Cade Cunningham's 24 points and nine assists would have won most nights. Rochester is 15-3 with four straight wins. The Stingrays slip from the 2 seed to the 3 seed.

Durham led 79-45 at halftime, which is less a score than a ruling. Anthony Edwards scored 30 on 14 shots, Tyler Herro hit six 3-pointers for 24, and the Destroyers led by 42 before coasting home 123-97 on a 16-point fourth quarter. Queens was missing Luka Dončić and Giannis Antetokounmpo, and RJ Barrett filled the gap by going 5-for-22. Durham climbs to the 2 seed at 12-6. The Pigeons stay the 8 seed at 6-12, four games from the playoff line.

Cambridge never trailed, led by 35 and scored 143 for its fourth win in a row, and all of that only keeps the Platypuses in the 4 seed at 10-8. Kevin Durant needed 12 shots for 26 points, Bam Adebayo had 22, and Zion Williamson scored 21 without attempting a 3-pointer. Nashville got 29 from Devin Booker and 25 on 9-for-12 shooting from Donovan Mitchell and lost 143-112 anyway. The Elephants drop from the 5 seed to the 7 seed, two games behind Cambridge.

Austin Reaves had 29 points and 10 assists, Stephen Curry made eight of 11 shots for 22, and the Gooners flattened Toronto 135-112 to reach 9-9 and the 5 seed, one game behind Cambridge. James Harden handed out 12 assists for the Jays and shot 3-for-13, missing all six of his 3-pointers. Reed Sheppard made six of seven from deep, so Toronto's shooting averaged out to a fourth straight loss. The Jays are the 10 seed at 5-13.

Ithaca has lost nine straight, and this one took effort. The Thunder led by six, trailed by only five after three quarters, then scored 18 in the fourth. Deni Avdija supplied the rest for Waltham: 35 points, 11 rebounds and seven 3-pointers in a 107-99 win, with Lauri Markkanen out with a torn ACL. Damian Lillard shot 6-for-17. The Bears move up to the 6 seed at 8-10, two games out of the 4 seed. Ithaca, 5-13, is the 9 seed only because Toronto exists.
